strongest_surviving_counterargument: A write-lock on the capability record between index and activate, or a content-hash of declared permissions bound into the index ticket, would close TOCTOU without moving the check to activate. This unit does not implement that lock. The live proof is that an unlocked index-time decision slips; the required placement is therefore activate-time re-read (or an equivalent bind of the grant hash). Residual: [REDACTED] DESIGN.json is absent, so a future DESIGN could pick hash-bind instead of re-read; either must still sit on every activation path. Selection-time caching is the same gap and is not an acceptable choke.
